author: Kammeh
body:
Hey guys :D kammy here again. Ive seen many of my in game friends and irl friends have clans and i also want to join one. I noticed there are nebula tourneys and to me thats really exciting. I want to join a clan and if some clans want me or if one clan wants me that would mean a lot :D please please i want to join a clan if anyone wants me :D

My best skill is rushing and i have learned to adapt my rushing ways according to the def and the situation of the match. I have broken many monuments and will continue to do so. Im also not bad at pvp. I have learned to strafe and get kill the average joe with ease. I love strategizing and if anything i am willing to share my ideas with anyone in my clan (if i get into a clan) thanks for reading and i hope you guys accept :D
